reason.en: The FoodKeeper record places 2-3 months in the refrigerate column and leaves the freezer column empty. Two to three months is a freezer figure; no bread keeps that long on a fridge shelf, and publishing it in the fridge row would mislead anyone reading the table without the article.
reason.zh: FoodKeeper 這筆紀錄把 2–3 個月放在「冷藏」欄，而冷凍欄是空的。兩三個月是冷凍等級的期限，沒有任何麵包能在冷藏室放這麼久；照原樣刊在冷藏欄，只看表格不看內文的人就會被誤導。

evidence.en: The sibling record in the same dataset, 'Whole wheat bread, homemade', states 'Refrigeration not recommended - bread will quickly dry out and become stale' and puts 3 months under freezer. The two records describe the same storage behaviour, so the figure has been moved to the column it belongs in.
evidence.zh: 同一份資料集裡的「全麥麵包（自製）」寫著「不建議冷藏——麵包會迅速乾燥變硬」，並把 3 個月放在冷凍欄。兩筆紀錄描述的是同一種保存行為，因此我們把這個數字移到它該在的欄位。

base.tips: May have shorter shelf life due to lack of preservatives.
Refrigeration is not recommended: chilling stales lean bread faster than room temperature does, though it does hold off mould.
Wrap well and freeze on the day it is baked.
